body: This template structures a cottage food label panel for a single product. Replace each field with your actual product information. Verify your state rules locally for exact wording, font size, and placement.

fields: Producer street address, city, state, ZIP:

sections.heading: Front Panel - Identity

body: List every ingredient by common name in descending order by weight, including sub-ingredients for mixes. Keep punctuation simple so the label stays legible.

fields: Colors, preservatives, or flavorings if any:

sections.heading: Ingredient List

body: Review the nine major allergens: milk, eggs, fish, shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, wheat, sesame, and soy. Declare each allergen present using plain words. If your state requires a home-kitchen warning, place it here exactly as the rule states.

fields: Contains statement (for example Contains: Wheat, Milk, Soy):
May-contain or shared-equipment note if true:

body: Use this cover sheet on top of each registration file. It summarizes what was filed, where, and when, so renewals are easy to track.
sections.heading: Filing Summary

body: Record the annual cap that applies to you and how you track it. Note which sales channels count in your state, such as farmers markets, roadside stands, or direct delivery.
